SSL PROVIDERS:

Providers are containers for algorithm implementations. Whenever a
cryptographic algorithm is used a provider is selected. It is that
provider implementation that actually does the required work.

1. FIPS:                 On
2. Base:                 On
3. Default:              On
4. Legacy:               Off
